newsitem.title: CHINA: China first half CPI up 4.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China first half CPI up 4.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's consumer price inflation rose 4.1 percent in the first six months compared with the year-ago period, the Economic Daily quoted State Statistical Bureau figures as showing.
It gave no figure for June alone.
That compared with consumer price inflation of 2.8 percent for May and 4.3 percent for the first five months.
China's retail price inflation rose by 0.8 percent year-on-year in June, state media has said.
That was the same as an increase of 0.8 percent for May and compared with 1.1 percent in April and 1.7 percent in March.
Chinese economists have said they expect benchmark retail price inflation to rise by 3.0-4.0 percent for the year, compared with a target of 6.0 percent for 1997 and down from 6.1 percent last year.
